district_name: Quarry Valley Unified Union School District

jurisdiction_sources.note: 16 V.S.A. section 603(a)(4)(B) inventory: Quarry Valley Unified Union School District, a unified union district in the Greater Rutland County Supervisory Union (member towns: Poultney, Proctor, West Rutland). Operates PK-12.
Greater Rutland County Supervisory Union (official site).

board.org_name: Quarry Valley Unified Union School Board

sources.note: Quarry Valley UUSD: nine directors, three per member town (proportional, town-only electorates -- Poultney's warning elects "One (1) Quarry Valley Unified Union School District Director for a term of three years" on the town ballot each year; Proctor's 2024 report lists its three director lines with 3-year terms, one "Not Filled"; West Rutland's officers list names three). NO memberships are minted: the current roster is established by no fetched official source -- the newest full roster is the district's March 6, 2024 letter (nine names, towns unattributed: Miser, Lohnes-Watulak, Smith, Ross, Gardner, Hier, Moser, Grabowski, Callahan -- roster of record, not minted). Resolving documents: the QVUUSD FY27 Annual Report directors list and the signed Feb. 24, 2026 annual meeting warning.
